method: Independent complete source/test review against M0-08 card; graph coverage not_tracked, direct source fallback. No duplicate test execution; native CI owned by parent.
checked: native path bytes and root dev/inode identity, no lossy display identity
disjoint writable state keys for same filenames/contents and actual Git linked worktrees
relative exclusion validation, internal state precedence, reason diagnostics
same-size preserved mtime content BLAKE3 detection
permission/removal/replacement typed diagnostics and explicit capability reporting
limitations: Concurrent ancestor-directory replacement is explicitly outside the spike model; do not claim this inventory is a filesystem security sandbox. Production design needs a separate race model.
Permission test on privileged hosts documents capability rather than claiming a negative proof.
Case sensitivity and invalid-UTF8 filename support depend on measured host filesystem capabilities.
